items.title: FAA lifts ground stop after four hours, but flight cancellations will stretch into the weekend
items.title_zh: 美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 在四小时后解除地面停止，但航班取消将持续到周末
items.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop on Friday afternoon, disrupting thousands of departing of flights.
items.summary_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局周五下午在全国范围内发布了地面停飞令，导致数千架航班起飞中断。

items.title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop that blocked takeoffs for hours
items.title_zh: 美国联邦航空局取消了导致起飞数小时受阻的全国范围内的地面停车
items.summary: Takeoffs from airports throughout the US largely stopped on Friday after the FAA issued a national ground stop at 3:44PM ET "due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety," while planes in the air will be allowed to land.
items.summary_zh: 周五，美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）“由于特殊情况和安全原因”于东部时间下午 3:44 发布全国地面停飞令后，美国各地机场的起飞基本停止，同时空中飞机将被允许降落。

items.title: AFM Dealmakers, Talent Agents and Hollywood Stars Left Stranded by Nationwide Flight Stoppage
items.title_zh: AFM 交易撮合者、人才经纪人和好莱坞明星因全国航班停飞而陷入困境
items.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration issued a halt on all U.S. flights on Friday at around 1 p.m. PT and didn’t lift the order until approximately four hours later.
items.summary_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局周五下午 1 点左右暂停所有美国航班。 PT 直到大约四个小时后才取消该命令。

items.title: Trump doesn’t plan to raise Nvidia, spy issue during China trip: U.S. officials
items.title_zh: 特朗普不打算在中国之行期间提出英伟达、间谍问题：美国官员
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned this week after reports of multiple affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy, Alice Huang.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 本周因多起婚外情报道而辞职，其中包括与涉嫌中国间谍的爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 的婚外情。

items.title: Kamal Khera Named New Canadian Consul General In Los Angeles, Will Meet With Studios
items.title_zh: 卡迈勒·凯拉 (Kamal Khera) 被任命为加拿大驻洛杉矶新总领事，将与工作室会面
items.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has appointed a new Consul General in Los Angeles, who says she hopes to inspire a renewed sense of unity between Canada and the U.S.
items.summary_zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼任命了一位新驻洛杉矶总领事，她表示希望激发加拿大和美国之间新的团结感。

items.title: SpaceX launches Starship in key test flight of massive rocket
items.title_zh: SpaceX 在大型火箭的关键试飞中发射 Starship
items.summary: The test flight is SpaceX's first attempt to ​catch both the Super Heavy booster and upper stage spacecraft of the rocket at its launch site in Starbase, Texas.
items.summary_zh: 此次试飞是 SpaceX 首次尝试在德克萨斯州 Starbase 的发射场捕获火箭的超重型助推器和上级航天器。

items.title: Amazon’s new Kindle Colorsoft is a premium e-reader with a premium price
items.title_zh: 亚马逊的新款 Kindle Colorsoft 是一款价格优惠的优质电子阅读器
items.summary: The latest model is lighter and thinner than its predecessor and features an edge-to-edge display. But if you already own the first-generation Colorsoft, there’s little reason to upgrade.
items.summary_zh: 最新型号比其前身更轻、更薄，并采用无边框显示屏。但如果您已经拥有第一代 Colorsoft，则没有理由升级。

items.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
items.title_zh: 风险投资家和创始人表示，黄仁勋的离职导致人工智能初创公司资金出现巨大缺口
items.summary: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达向黄仁勋领导下的人工智能初创公司投入了数百亿美元。没有他的掌舵，创始人和风险投资公司将面临较小的支票和较低的估值。

items.title: I’m a semi-competitive shopper. These are my 12 favorite finds for someone who has everything
items.title_zh: 我是一个半竞争性的购物者。对于拥有一切的人来说，这是我最喜欢的 12 件发现
items.summary: Thoughtful, elevated gifts for the person impossible to shop for on your list – from tea warmers to butter-shaped dishes The nine best personalized gifts Sign up for the Filter US newsletter, your weekly guide to buying fewer, better things The “has everything” person is, in…
items.summary_zh: 为您清单上不可能购买的人提供贴心、高档的礼物 - 从茶器到黄油形状的餐具 九种最佳个性化礼物 订阅 Filter US 时事通讯，您的每周指南，购买更少、更好的东西 “拥有一切”的人，在……

items.title: She gets 16 pelvic exams a day – so yours don’t hurt
items.title_zh: 她每天接受 16 次骨盆检查——这样你的就不会受伤
items.summary: Molly Callahan, a gynecological teaching assistant, helps medical students practice pap smears and breast exams On her busiest days, Molly Callahan, has 16 speculums inserted into her vagina.
items.summary_zh: 莫莉·卡拉汉 (Molly Callahan) 是一名妇科助教，帮助医学生练习子宫颈抹片检查和乳房检查。在莫莉·卡拉汉 (Molly Callahan) 最忙碌的日子里，她的阴道里插入了 16 个窥器。
